summary: Headless native quote insertion behind the single selection toolbar; no independent floating UI.

edits.why: Capture only the shared validated snapshot and keep it through rendering loss. No standalone quote button is created or positioned. Cross-message metadata remains unscoped to a single turn.
Use only the active session that owns the validated selection snapshot.
Resolve the input facade once for both insertion paths.
Insert through the host action even when its button is disabled. Fall back only when the action is missing.
Selection cancellation and scroll recovery belong to the coordinator; the quote core has no independent pointer/scroll UI lifecycle.
Retiring an old quote core must not remove the successor API.
Only the annotation toolbar renders UI. Quote insertion is exposed as an action service, with no CSS hiding workaround or fallback floating button.
Remove the floating-button creation, geometry and hiding functions from the emitted body. Retain only error-notice styling.
Discard the quote snapshot without looking for a button to hide.
Locale updates only refresh an existing error notice.
edits.replace: // No floating quote button to localize.
